title: Songpyeon with Chive and Korean Chili Flakes
description: A traditional Korean tteokbokki-inspired recipe featuring chewy rice cakes and a spicy kick.

ingredients.name: Songpyeon rice cakes
ingredients.notes: available at Korean grocery stores or online

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the songpyeon rice cakes and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the rice cakes from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, heat the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped chives and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the gochujang and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soy sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the brown sugar (if using) and cook for 1 minute.
Return the rice cakes to the skillet and toss with the sauce until well combined.
